propositions: Every typed configuration key emitted through _SECTION_CLASSES requires a nonempty public_description field to document user-visible effects or operational consequences.

The configuration reference generator must validate presence and non-emptiness of public_description metadata for all emitted fields and fail generation when metadata is missing or empty, naming the offending key.

Generated descriptions must be field-local, co-located with dataclass definitions to maintain single source of truth, distinct from internal implementation comments, and must escape table-sensitive Markdown content correctly.

Module-size constraints require schema modules to remain below 800 lines; extraction of VerifyConfig validation helpers preserves both _config_schema.py and _config_coercion.py under the limit while maintaining canonical schema source integrity.
Configuration coercion, runtime behavior, default values, default factories, and typed field annotations must remain unchanged by the addition of description metadata and generator enhancement.
